name: local-llm-background-review-never-starts
prompt: Use $work-closeout for this advisory classification. Do not use tools, run commands, edit files, or start agents. Timeline: at closeout for current head abc123, the lifecycle surface is readable but no matching Background Review lifecycle evidence is visible, and the product can start the review only after the final response. At a later observation the lifecycle surface is still readable and still shows no matching evidence because no review ever started. Classify both observations from the skill guidance. A terminal_claim value says whether the evidence supports reporting a terminal lifecycle state. original_summary_action says whether later evidence should replace text in the original point-in-time summary. follow_up_action says whether the later observation needs a durable follow-up to that summary. Return final answer only as these key=value lines with no markdown and no spaces around equals: initial_state, initial_terminal_claim, safe_exit_at_closeout, later_state, later_terminal_claim, original_summary_action, follow_up_action. Allowed states: not-yet-observable, in-flight, observation-unavailable, completed, cancelled, superseded, failed, skipped. Allowed yes/no values: yes, no. Allowed summary actions: preserve, rewrite. Allowed follow-up actions: add, none.
